_doc: SPINOFF-IDEAS-1: the free-plan headroom snapshot the idea loop plans against. Refreshed by `python3 -m foundation ideas --headroom --apply` from Cloudflare's GraphQL analytics when CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN is bound (same query as seed/worker/src/freetier.js); with no token the snapshot is kept and marked stale after 48 h, which holds cadence at the degrade level. Day figures below are measured 2026-11-17 (D1 reads: ultrastable-org ~2.7M/day + ultrastable-ops ~0.3M/day; AI: 8,068 neurons in 7 days) and are labelled estimates where no daily sample exists.
